terminology.scene: an object-independent physical workspace grouped by source metadata and visually stable background geometry
terminology.source_scene: the original DROID grouping keyed by normalized lab/building/robot_serial/scene_id
terminology.setup: episodes in one scene sharing the same asset-relevant object inventory

method.hierarchy: scene -> setup -> episode; source_scene is retained as provenance metadata
method.visual_evidence: one chronological ext-camera start frame for every retrievable Episode (73732/74896), plus stratified contact-sheet review recorded in the Setup spec
method.scene_group_rule: group setups when lab, building, robot identity, fixed fixtures, work surface, and background geometry indicate the same physical workspace; ignore portable objects and source scene UID
method.setup_split_rule: within a scene, split when a required portable object or object variant/count changes
method.source_scene_role: DROID source scene UID is provenance only and is not a physical-space boundary
method.task_metadata_role: task text selects and names audit strata only; it never overrides visual object evidence

complexity.formula: S * 100 * (0.25 * min(P, 6) / 6 + 0.40 * min(O, 5) / 5 + 0.20 * min(R, 4) / 4 + 0.15 * min(duration_sec, 60) / 60); S = 0.65 for freeform, otherwise 1.00

inputs.P: semantic manipulation phases parsed from task family and explicit consecutive-task count
inputs.O: interacted object load from task semantics with a small capped setup-inventory contribution; highest-weight component at 40 percent
inputs.R: container, stack, orientation, indexed-target, sequence, and reset path constraints
inputs.duration_sec: trajectory duration, capped at 60 seconds, used only as an execution/path-effort proxy
inputs.S: task-specificity multiplier: 0.65 when task_family contains freeform, otherwise 1.00

complexity.representative_rule: success-first: choose the highest-complexity successful Episode with media; only when no successful Episode exists retain a clearly marked inspection fallback; Scene representatives prefer successful Setup representatives
complexity.limitation: Trajectory duration is not geometric end-effector path length. Freeform task metadata cannot prove concrete object/path complexity, so it is uncertainty-discounted. Add proprioceptive path distance later when that source signal is available.

method.confidence_note: Low-confidence transition boundaries remain explicit instead of being forced into a larger Setup.
